purpose: Describe movement inward or an action becoming deep or thorough.
keywords: The cat slipped into the box.
I was deep in thought about the future.
It suddenly grew cold at nightfall.
restrictions: Meanings depend on the established compound verb.
mistake: Not every verb can combine freely with 込む; learn the compound as a unit.
